section.presidentLegend1: We are not just judging films, but visions of desirable futures created with tools that are still beyond our grasp. This is the beginning of a new era.
section.presidentLegend2: Multi-award-winning director Julien Valros brings his expert perspective to new forms of digital storytelling.
section.memberLegend: Experts, creators and visionaries gathered to deliberate on the official selection.
section.notationLegend: The jury is committed to evaluating each short film according to four fundamental pillars to ensure fairness between participants.
section.desc_1: Level of innovation and creative use of AI tools.
section.desc_2: Artistic quality and consistency of the generated visual universe.
section.desc_3: The power of the story and its emotional impact on the audience.
section.desc_4: The film's ability to have a lasting impact on the viewer.
